modules.game_goal: Interactive warm-up game with soccer-themed physical activities to engage students in mimicking actions such as kicking, jumping, hopping, catching, throwing, skipping, running, and climbing.

evidence.text_excerpt: Warm up, warm up, everybody warm up. There are 8 soccer balls. Click to have one ball bounce in...
evidence.image_summary: A stylized representation of a soccer field focusing on the goal area.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you kick like her? Kick four times.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a martial artist performing a flying kick.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you jump like him? Jump over six tyres.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a young boy jumping over tires.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you hop like her? Hop fives times.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon-style illustration of a young girl in a playful pose.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you catch like him? Catch a ball three times.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a boy in a catching stance with a ball in the mid-air.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you throw like him? Throw the ball twice.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a young boy engaged in playing cricket.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you skip like him? Skip eight times.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a boy jumping rope.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you run like her? Run on the spot for 10 counts.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a young girl in a running motion.

evidence.text_excerpt: Can you climb like her? Climb up one rock.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of a child climbing viewed from behind.

modules.game_goal: Follow the leader game where learners touch named body parts and complete specific physical actions as instructed.

evidence.text_excerpt: The learners take turns choosing a number around the body. Click on the number chosen to be directed to a slide with an action.
Follow the leader. The learners need to figure out what they must touch...
The learners need to figure out what they must touch. Read the added instruction to them.
evidence.image_summary: Illustration of body parts labeled on a cartoon boy.

evidence.text_excerpt: The learners need to figure out what they must touch. Read the added instruction to them...
evidence.image_summary: Labeled boxes with illustrations of body parts connected to the corresponding parts on the boy.

evidence.text_excerpt: Hold it and walk around in a circle.
evidence.image_summary: Educational illustration with labeled boxes of body parts connected to a cartoon boy.

evidence.text_excerpt: And criss cross your legs four times.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon boy with labeled boxes identifying body parts.

evidence.text_excerpt: And do seven jumping jacks.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon boy with labeled boxes of body parts.

evidence.text_excerpt: And touch your toes, then put your hands on your hips.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon boy with labeled boxes identifying body parts.

evidence.text_excerpt: And stick out your tongue, then bend to your left side.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon boy with labeled boxes of body parts.

evidence.text_excerpt: And nod your head twice, then sit back down.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon boy with labeled boxes identifying body parts.

evidence.text_excerpt: And touch your shoulders, then do a little dance.
evidence.image_summary: Cartoon boy with labeled boxes identifying body parts.
